resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1933 is the build year in the Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com and Forest Service lists, and in the 1981 Hartig passage quoted by the Forest Lookouts index. The index's summary line giving 1934 for the erection conflicts with that passage, which says the tower was finished in 1933 and first manned in 1934.

sources.title: Pete King Fire Hit by Tree Fatalities 1934

notes_for_editor: Five sources agree on the 1933 tower and the 1934 burn in the Pete King Fire. Design words differ: pole (Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com), round timber (Forest Lookouts index summary line) and log (Hartig 1981, as quoted). The Forest Service list has a second Grouse Point entry, '6 miles S of Powell RS', L-4 tower, 1934, burned; and idahofirelookouts.com has a second page (selway-region/grouse-point-lookout-2) with elevation unknown. These may be the same site recorded twice; I did not verify that, so check before merging or adding a record. No source describes the site today. Access level left unset: no source states it. Russell Stadtman's name comes from a secondary quotation of Hartig (1981) on the Forest Lookouts index.
